lines.en: We've never stolen an idea from anyone,
so why don't you two little girls just...
Sam, you're not supposed to get swingy unless I say it's okay.
Man, we all love your web show.
Now listen, when you guys arrive at the hospital,
the doctors are gonna ask you what you got beat with.
And it was filled with butter.
You can't fight in front of a baby, it's against the babysitter code!
As soon as those two freaks walk back in here...
- Come on, man! - In any way, that butter sock is gross.
- I change the butter once a month. - Do you really?
Uh... Sam, take the head off that dummy.
Uh... I don't know, I hate to damage someone else's property.
You know, I oughta bust you up.
You're gonna bust up a kid half your size.
Uh, sit down, honey, and I'll bust you up too.
All right. We've got five seconds to get out of here.
Five, four, three, two, one, out!
Maybe I've gone soft. But my butter hasn't.
What are you gonna do? You're alone.
Well, I hope your 30 friends can see in the dark.
- Shut up the lights! - I can't see nothing!
- Where is she? - Get him, Sam!
Take him out, Sam. Do it. Come on!
I'm gonna have to ask you to leave my restaurant.
Well, I'm gonna have to do this.
So, we have the lawyers, the money, and therefore the power
to steal any ideas we want.
And there's nothing you can do about it.
Okay, now that we all know Steven's a stinkin' cheater,
Once again, I offer the butter sock.
We don't just want to hurt Steven.
- What is that? - I'm changing the butter in my butter sock.
